content.short: SurfLayer is a hub for daily on-chain rituals like GM, deploy and bridge across 100+ EVM chains.
content.description: SurfLayer lets users build an on-chain identity through daily rituals such as sending a GM, deploying a contract, voting and bridging, earning points and rewards across more than 70 mainnets. Unichain appears among its networks, and it is listed in Blockscout's Unichain and World Chain marketplaces and as a World mini app.
content.meta: SurfLayer offers daily on-chain GM, deploy and bridge rituals with rewards on Unichain and World Chain.
